outcome: Successful bridging to elective arterial switch operation (ASO)
cohort: A six-month-old male patient with dextrocardia, situs inversus, d-TGA/IVS, persistent cyanosis, severe hypoxemia, metabolic acidosis, and LV regression.
finding: Transcatheter PDA recanalization and interatrial septal stenting represent a viable bridge to arterial switch operation in late-presenting d-TGA/IVS patients.
